capabilities: Import .eml and .msg files as Markdown notes
Convert HTML email bodies to Markdown
Extract attachments to a configured folder and link them
Write YAML frontmatter with sender, recipients, date, and Message-ID
Watch a folder and import new email files automatically
disambiguation: Not a mail client; it only converts email files already saved to disk, with no Outlook, IMAP, or Exchange connection.
extras: Desktop only. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import email files from disk as clean Markdown notes with extracted attachments and metadata.
summary: Email importer that converts .eml and .msg files on disk into Markdown notes with attachments, inline images, and structured frontmatter.
